core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hadee corresponds to the Arabic form حادي (Arabic root ه د ي (h-d-y); هادٍ / حادي (hādī)). Its core sense is guide, leader. Hadee is Arabic هادٍ (hādī) 'guide', written with the initial letter ح in South Asian usage (حادي — the form also used of someone who urges camels on with song). The source gloss 'guide, helper' is substantially correct. The word هادٍ occurs in the Qur'an (e.g. 25:31).
